text: Comment on Myntra haul video: I always wishlist the same kurtis you show but wait for discount. Price is too high at MRP so purchase gets postponed every time.

I compare both apps after shortlisting. Whichever has better coupon wins. Wishlist on Myntra is just step one — I search elsewhere before purchasing.
Saved guest outfits for a wedding in August. Still thinking about styling and accessories. Occasion timing means I delay buying from wishlist until closer to the date.
After a bad return pickup I hesitate on every wishlisted item. Logistics friction makes me bookmark passively instead of purchasing online fashion.
Your size guide helped but I'm still confused between M and L for this brand. Shortlist is ready; purchase delayed until more fit reviews drop.
Confession: my wishlist is a digital moodboard. I rarely convert. Passive bookmarking feels productive but doesn't lead to purchase.
